learning_outcomes.text: Can define the basic concepts of solar energy.
Can calculate solar angles, day length, local and solar time.
Learns the solar radiation coming to the earth and can make calculations.
Can make thermal and performance calculations of different types of solar collectors.
Learns different applications and system calculations related to solar energy.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental concepts and definitions, radiation processes and properties.
Solar energy, technology of solar energy and applications.
Solar radiation, emissivity, absorption, reflection and transmissivity.
Calculation of solar radiation on horizontal and sloped surfaces.
Transmission of solar radiation through glass and plastics.
Solar geometry; angles, direct and emitted radiation.
Performance and theory of flat solar collectors.
Performance and theory of flat solar collectors.
House heating, passive and active systems.
Active, passive and hybrid building heating, solar cooling.
Solar industrial process heat, solar thermal power systems.
bibliography: Solar Energy Engineering: Processes and Systems, S. A Kalogirou, Elsevier, Second Edition
Solar Engineering of Thermal Processes, J. A. Duffie and W. A. Beckman, John Wiley & Sons, Inc, Fourth Edition.
